title: The multiclass ARKA framework for developing improved q-RASAR models for environmental toxicity endpoints
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00068H, Paper
Arkaprava Banerjee, Kunal Roy
A multiclass-ARKA framework is introduced for developing robust and predictive regression-based quantitative read-across-structure–activity relationship (q-RASAR) models to deal with limited quantitative environmental toxicity data.
